newsitem.title: USA: Continental Air to outline views on competition.
newsitem.headline: Continental Air to outline views on competition.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc on Wednesday said it was set to make specific recommendations on ensuring that a proposed alliance between British Airways Plc and AMR Corp's American Airlines would not undermine competition in the industry.
The Houston-based airline has applied for the right to provide service between London's Heathrow Airport and Cleveland, Houston and Newark, N.J. -- its three U.S. hubs.
Continental on Thursday will outline its position on the proposed alliance in a filing with the U.K. Office of Fair Trading.
